caption:
Can someone explain why one missed payment can follow you for years… but paying on time for years barely gets a thank-you? 😤

You do everything right for 5 years and the score moves a few points.

Miss one and it drops fast.

Does this feel fair to you?
first_comment: What's the most frustrating thing about how credit scores work? 👇

instagram.first_comment: Vent here. We read every comment. @creditscoretruths

card.headline: Years of on-time payments. One miss. Score drops.
card.sub: Why does it feel so unfair?
